scope: Current published MCP catalog plus prioritized capability families. Existing registration is not retroactive conformance certification.

capabilities.outcome: Prepare, poll and retry an existing media asset
capabilities.authority: Project-scoped cached preparation; respect optional analysis settings; no import or timeline mutation.
capabilities.acceptance: Existing ready asset reuses work; failure identifies stage; retry preserves job/source identity; missing preview blocks placement.

capabilities.outcome: Prepare reusable outline/Scratchpad derivatives from a cutout receipt
capabilities.authority: Versioned derivative only; retain raw cutout/source mappings and require preview readiness.
capabilities.acceptance: Repeat request reuses verified result; parent untouched; source clock and alpha valid; unsupported treatment fails with actionable guidance.

capabilities.outcome: Prepare transcript/alignment and compile captions for review
capabilities.authority: Transcription and MFA alignment are distinct; reviewed transcript required for alignment-dependent edits; return proposals, never invoke direct apply.
capabilities.acceptance: Unknown words and unavailable MFA surface blockers; captions preserve source mapping; no timeline write; proposal preflight and human review remain required.

capabilities.outcome: Discover capabilities, recipes and Templates gallery templates and load permitted tool families
capabilities.authority: Session schema exposure only; fixed harness allowlist and write gates remain authoritative.
capabilities.acceptance: Pagination, denied family loading, hidden dispatch rejection, recipe version validation, full versus editing profile comparison, and every gallery template resolving by its copied request with the editor unavailable reported.

capabilities.outcome: Prepare source-bound planar tracks for editable text attachments
capabilities.authority: Preparation jobs and immutable track receipts only; placement requires a proposal.
capabilities.acceptance: Synthetic perspective, source-clock and lost-track tests plus encoded renderer and independent UI acceptance.

capabilities.outcome: Verify isolated Rust source decoding through the shared compositor and export pipeline
capabilities.authority: Reads isolated project copies; writes engineering comparison artifacts only; no timeline edits or delivery API
capabilities.acceptance: Fail closed; enforce source clocks, registered effect behavior, repeated seeks, encoded structure and independent audiovisual acceptance

editor_agent.reason: Renderer verification for repository development; no MCP tool and not an editing operation.

capabilities.outcome: Inventory GPU admission through production timeline projection and verify the opt-in GPU preview against synthetic standard-renderer and encoded references
capabilities.authority: Reads working cuts for private admission/performance receipts and creates only named synthetic media fixtures in explicitly isolated storage; no creator timeline writes or user-project exports
capabilities.acceptance: Complete supported picture, repeated seeks, bounded resources and every-frame encoded reference comparisons; caption layout and speech cases additionally require visible neutral-control differences and deterministic word/gap states; failures remain visible

editor_agent.reason: Renderer verification for repository development; no MCP tool and not an editing operation.

capabilities.outcome: Let the in-editor Claude or Codex agent run independent read-only or preparation tasks in parallel helper sessions and use their reports
capabilities.authority: Host tool agent_delegate in desktop chat only. Helpers share the project lease, use the same provider and model, read and prepare through a fixed allowlist, and cannot create proposals, record feedback, change the timeline, approve or delegate. Local models do not delegate.
capabilities.acceptance: Bounded tasks, concurrency and deadline; per-helper journals; cancellation follows the main turn; reports return as evidence; provider smoke run with real Claude and Codex helpers before widening the allowlist.

editor_agent.reason: agent_delegate is a desktop host tool supplied by the editing tool bridge, not an MCP tool; coding agents use their own sub-agents.

capabilities.outcome: Let the agent author motion graphics and sounds as code, optionally declare creator controls, actors and holds, and keep an append-only audit trail with the creator's review rating; save a creator's own graphic with its linked sounds to their personal Library and reuse it in other projects
capabilities.authority: Agent preparation: writes composition and sound source under hyperframes/<id>/ and sounds/<id>/, renders candidates, and appends audit events. Never edits the timeline, approves or exports; the proposal that places the result is the human review point, where the creator may rate the motion. Library tools write only the personal Library (save) or prepare renders in the target project (use); placing still goes through a proposal.
capabilities.acceptance: Controls file optional and never coverage-gated; declared controls the code ignores fail check; equal source, values and seed give identical sound bytes; every check and render appends audit events; project-health reports per-item revisions, edits, missed controls and ratings.

capabilities.outcome: Break supplied footage into a planned storyboard of beats and shots, with visuals shown over shots, that the creator reviews and tunes
capabilities.authority: Writes only the freeform storyboard, on the creator's request, as one revision-checked Undo step; shots reference original source windows; no cuts, timeline writes, generation or approval. Build timeline stays a human action.
capabilities.acceptance: A draft from a talking take saves as one Undo step with beats, notes, text, transitions and visuals over shots; stale revisions, unknown or unprepared sources, out-of-range windows, audio shots or visuals, and visuals outside or overlapping within their shot are refused without changing the board; an open Storyboard page adopts the new revision; Build timeline keeps each talking window one continuous clip with visuals on the lane above.

capabilities.outcome: Recreate a reference video with other people: the reference split into beats at its cuts, a cast with photos, who appears in each beat, per-beat prices, and generated takes the creator chooses as each beat's footage
capabilities.authority: Writes only the Follow-reference storyboard plan, on the creator's request, as one revision-checked Undo step, and quotes prices for free. Generation spends credits only from the creator's Recast click in the Storyboard; choosing a take, Build timeline and approval stay human actions.
capabilities.acceptance: A plan without beats splits the reference at its shot cuts and saves as one Undo step with cast and per-beat people; unknown cast names, non-photo cast sources, overlapping or out-of-range beats and stale revisions are refused without changing the board; quotes pad short beats to the model's minimum window; a chosen take is kept in the Library and becomes the beat's selected footage trimmed back to the beat.

capabilities.outcome: Find library sound effects and prepare a cue-specific audition: picture, speech and audio context, peak-aligned leveled candidates with ready create_audio operations, and a loudness-alignment image
capabilities.authority: Read-only catalog and timeline reads; never edits the timeline. Placement happens through proposal_create, where the creator listens and chooses.
capabilities.acceptance: Ranking respects role, query, duration and audibility; each candidate's measured peak lands on the cue; speech basis is reported; operations validate in proposal_create; the image is returned as MCP image content.

capabilities.outcome: Choose where DreamCut keeps projects and move existing projects into the creator's DreamCut Library
capabilities.authority: Creates a Library only in an empty folder and saves the creator's choice; moves only the projects the creator confirmed from a shown plan; never deletes, merges or overwrites projects; no timeline edits.
capabilities.acceptance: A new Library is created at the suggested or chosen folder; an existing one is chosen; a migration plan lists projects and sizes; only confirmed projects move (rename on one disk, verified copy keeping originals across disks); conflicts are skipped; a newer Library is refused.

capabilities.outcome: Open the local DreamCut editor for the creator from their coding agent
capabilities.authority: Starts the local editor bound to 127.0.0.1 and returns a single-use, short-lived browser sign-in link; no project, timeline or file changes.
capabilities.acceptance: The editor starts or is reused; the link signs a browser in once and expires; requests without the session, with a foreign Host or Origin, or cross-site are refused.

editor_agent.reason: The in-editor agent already runs inside the open editor.

editor_agent_contract: Each capability states whether the in-editor agent gets its MCP tools. The editor session's families and the harness operator allowlist are derived from these fields; coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) use the same MCP server. See docs/standards/agent-surface-parity.md.
